note: Bridges the vocabulary gap between the feed (mixed Danish/English, marketing words) and the taxonomy (Danish slugs). Kept deliberately small: only categories that matter for a retargeting banner and that string matching cannot reach. ORDER MATTERS - the first entry whose terms match wins, so accessories come before the devices they are named after ('iPhone cover' is a cover, not a phone). All words are ASCII-folded the same way product names are (o for oe, a for ae/aa). Every path is validated against categories.json at load time.
